findings.highlight: Those attacks are continuous, without hesitation.
findings.evidenceJa: そこに間断はなく、容赦はない。
findings.governingReading: The exchange has neither pause nor mercy; every blow carries lethal intent.
findings.explanation: The attacks' lack of mercy becomes lack of hesitation.

findings.highlight: Archer cannot handle Lancer's attacks that he was able to dodge that night.
findings.evidenceJa: あの夜防ぎきったランサーの槍を、アーチャーは捌ききれない。
findings.governingReading: He completely defended against Lancer's spear on the earlier night and has survived this far now by using that knowledge to parry or contain it.
findings.explanation: Archer's prior and present defense against the spear becomes dodging.

findings.highlight: it is a simple weapon that anyone can gain from training in a frank manner.
findings.evidenceJa: 愚直なまでに修練を重ねれば誰にでも手が届く、凡人故の武器だった。
findings.governingReading: Mind's Eye is reachable by anyone who piles up training with almost foolish single-minded persistence; it is an acquired ordinary person's weapon, unlike Saber's innate instinct.
findings.explanation: Dogged, almost plodding training becomes training in a frank manner.

findings.highlight: He observes the disgruntled bowman in red.
findings.evidenceJa: どうも納得がいかぬ、と赤い弓兵を観察する。
findings.governingReading: Lancer pauses to inspect Archer because something does not add up to him, leading into his questioning of Archer's strength and his own restraint.
findings.explanation: Lancer's sense that something does not add up becomes Archer's disgruntlement. This removes the thought that leads into Lancer questioning his own performance.

findings.highlight: He has been at an advantage and should not last a few more blows
findings.evidenceJa: とうに劣勢、あと数合も保つまいが
findings.governingReading: Archer has long been on the losing side and will not last several more exchanges, yet he has still received Lancer's full-force spear.
findings.explanation: Archer's long-standing disadvantage is reversed into an advantage.

findings.highlight: What is there in a serious battle?
findings.evidenceJa: このような戦闘で本気になったところで何がある。
findings.governingReading: Lancer asks what getting serious in this kind of combat would accomplish, before distinguishing ordinary exchanges from using a fatal Noble Phantasm.
findings.explanation: Lancer's question about the point of getting serious in this particular exchange becomes a general question about serious battle. His subsequent reasoning survives, but its opening distinction is blurred.

findings.highlight: The cause seems to be the expression of gratitude that he had never heard before.
findings.evidenceJa: その原因は、つい先ほど耳にした、なんでもない礼らしい。
findings.governingReading: Lancer realizes that the cause of his restraint seems to be the unremarkable thanks he heard only a short while ago.
findings.explanation: Rin's casual thanks just heard becomes gratitude Lancer had never heard before.

findings.highlight: Lancer's full-force blow, as if he is about to hit himself, is offset by Archer's full-force attack.
findings.evidenceJa: 自身に叩きつけるようなランサー渾身の一撃は、同じくアーチャー渾身の一撃によって相殺された。
findings.governingReading: The action is an all-out Lancer attack against Archer, canceled by an equally all-out Archer attack; neither combatant is about to hit himself.
findings.explanation: Lancer's all-out blow is made to look self-directed.

findings.highlight: It is not the matter of distance to thrust his spear.
findings.evidenceJa: 槍を突き出す、どころの間合いではない。
findings.governingReading: The distance is far beyond any range from which one would thrust a spear.
findings.explanation: The range explanation is not grammatical English.

findings.highlight: the Noble Phantasm that blocks it cannot be superficial.
findings.evidenceJa: 防ぐ宝具は生半可な物では済まされまい
findings.governingReading: If the spear follows its legend, no half-measure or ordinary Noble Phantasm will suffice to block it.
findings.explanation: A Noble Phantasm powerful enough to stop the legendary spear becomes one that is not superficial.

findings.highlight: He holds up the magical spear that "always pierces the heart once it is thrust."
findings.evidenceJa: 大きく振りかぶった腕には“放てば必ず心臓を貫く”魔槍。
findings.governingReading: After explicitly saying Lancer will not thrust, the narration describes the spear's property when released or thrown and the legend of its scattering arrowheads when cast at an enemy.
findings.explanation: The thrown Gáe Bolg is twice changed into a thrust.

findings.highlight: The spear of causality respond to the words.
findings.evidenceJa: 紡がれる言葉に因果の槍が呼応する。
findings.governingReading: The spear of causality responds to the words being spun.
findings.explanation: The sentence introducing the Noble Phantasm's response has broken agreement.

findings.highlight: It cannot be avoided nor dodged.
findings.evidenceJa: 躱す事も出来ず、防ぐ事も出来ない。
findings.governingReading: Gáe Bolg cannot be evaded and cannot be blocked; the absolute claim sets up the dramatic contradiction of Rho Aias stopping it.
findings.explanation: The spear's impossibility of both evasion and defense becomes two statements about evasion.

findings.highlight: swirling up a storm of wind and scattering debris.
findings.evidenceJa: 暴風と高熱を残骸として巻き散らしながら
findings.governingReading: The spear scatters violent wind and intense heat as the wreckage or residue of its arrested force.
findings.explanation: Intense heat is replaced by physical debris in the collision image.

findings.highlight: the seventh petal that has never been pierced through
findings.evidenceJa: 決して貫けなかったと言われる七枚目
findings.governingReading: The spear reaches the seventh petal, which is said never to have been pierced, and still does not slow.
findings.explanation: A legendary claim about the seventh petal becomes direct fact.
